name: @dreamteamer/workflows
description: dt prove, dt land and dt worktree — behaviour proofs for a dreamteamer workspace's artifacts, and the worktree lifecycle that brings a second checkout's records home

dreamteamer.title: Workflows
dreamteamer.description: Behaviour proofs and the worktree lifecycle: `dt prove` runs a `proofs/` source against a skill, command, binding or module script and answers with an exit code, `dt worktree` cuts, lists and removes linked checkouts, and `dt land` rebases a worktree's commits onto the primary branch and retires it.
